environment.description: Same Go binary deployed in EKS (1.28) pod within a service mesh (Istio 1.20). The Istio sidecar enforces PeerAuthentication in STRICT mTLS mode for the namespace, meaning all inbound connections must present a valid SPIFFE identity from the mesh trust domain (spiffe://cluster.local/ns/internal/sa/ws-client). Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy resource scoped to the ws-service workload requires the source principal to match 'cluster.local/ns/internal/sa/ws-client' AND the request path /ws to carry a valid request header 'x-mesh-session-id' that is injected only by the Envoy sidecar of authorized upstream pods. The Envoy filter also enforces per-connection token binding: the x-mesh-session-id is cryptographically bound to the mTLS session and rotated every 45 seconds (offset from the application's 60s rotation). Cross-origin WebSocket upgrade requests from external sources cannot satisfy the mTLS handshake requirement because they lack a valid SVID certificate issued by the mesh CA (istiod). The CheckOrigin permissiveness is irrelevant because the Envoy sidecar rejects the TCP connection before it reaches the application container.

config.envoy_filter: per-connection session binding with 45s rotation, header x-mesh-session-id
config.network_policy: Calico deny-all ingress except from pods with label app=ws-client in namespace internal
config.mesh_ca: istiod with intermediate CA, SVID lifetime 1h
config.external_access: no Istio Gateway or VirtualService exposes /ws externally
